description: A peer that answers the Ed4 PHYSICAL LINK REQUEST with a WARNING is recorded as not Ed4, and link establishment is repeated with the Ed4 bit clear.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for ARQ (service type tx_mode 1, delivery confirmation none) and gets S_BIND_ACCEPTED with MTU 2048 (A-0041, A-0047). At 0 it sends an S_UNIDATA_REQUEST (priority 0, SAP 9 at 0.0.1.3, DELIVERY MODE default, TTL 0, so TTD = 1296000000 ms, U_PDU "ping"). ARQ data needs a soft link first, so the SIS holds the U_PDU and asks the CAS for a physical link (A-0008, A-0188, A-0193). The CAS starts the Caller procedure (B-0196, B-0202): link_state calling, and a PHYSICAL LINK REQUEST with Ed4 set, since the peer's edition is unknown (B-0124, B-0408), Short clear (B-0409) and LINK clear (B-0127), octet 12, handed to the DTS for a type 8 D_PDU (B-0129). Contention: LBT 30000 (K-0070), slot 15, 45000 ms; at 75000 the request goes out. Its transmission ends at 80550, and only then does cas.link_request/0.0.1.3 start, with cas.link_request_timeout_ms (B-0203, B-0204, B-0400, C-1100). At 91000, from 0.0.1.3 (EOT 10, end 96000), a WARNING D_PDU (received frame type 8, reason 2) while our Ed4 request is outstanding. The DTS tells the CAS (D_WARNING_RECEIVED, C-0589); the CAS records the peer as not Ed4 (B-0229, B-0315, B-0408), stops its timer and starts link establishment again with Ed4 clear (B-0123, B-0230, B-0411): octet 10. Burst end 92000: csma.vdcd_end 4000; at 96000 rule 1, slot 4, 12000 ms; at 108000 the request goes out (C_PDU ID 1); at 113550 the timer starts. At 121000 the peer accepts with Ed4 clear (octet 20): link made (B-0219), the Ed3 family in force (B-0139, C-0044), link_state linked, and the SIS passes the held U_PDU down; dts.ttd at its TTD, 1296000000 - 121000 ms (C-1050). Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150, 25 bytes and 4800 ms a block, so one type 8 D_PDU carrying a one-byte C_PDU (address size 3, C-0133) fills a block exactly and a one-block transmission lasts 5550 ms, EOT and reception window ceil(4950 / 500) = 10 (C-0104, C-1043, C-0350). Every C_PDU of this scenario is a one-octet CAS-1 C_PDU sent once in a type 8 D_PDU (B-0129, B-0143, B-0152, B-0191), C_PDU IDs from 0 (C-1040), EOW 0. Seed 0 draws uniform(16) = 15 then 4: contention waits 45000 then 12000 ms (K-0080). Settings: cas.max_links, cas.link_request_timeout_ms 60000, cas.link_request_retries and cas.first_data_timeout_ms 120000.
